name: Delicious Digital Product Manager
author: deliciousdesignperth

sections.description:
Delicious Digital Product Manager is a lightweight digital product system for WordPress. It lets you create digital products, protect downloadable files, accept manual bank transfer orders, fulfil paid orders and give customers secure access to their purchases.

The Free edition includes:

  • Digital product and category management
  • Protected file storage and authenticated downloads
  • Manual bank transfer purchasing
  • Pending and fulfilled order management
  • Customer and administrator order emails
  • Customer accounts and a My Digital Products portal
  • Manual customer access management
  • Download limits and access expiry
  • Product, category, purchase and customer account shortcodes
  • Appearance controls
  • Five Divi 5 modules when Divi 5 is installed

Divi is optional. Digital Product Manager works with standard WordPress pages and shortcodes without Divi.

Digital Product Manager Pro is a separate product. It adds automated Stripe payments, discount codes, PDF invoices and receipts, software licensing, multi-licence customer accounts, licence packs and Agency/Unlimited tiers, automatic licensed WordPress packages, private software update delivery, updates and renewals, Sale pricing, stock control, and additional Divi 5 functionality.

2.3.1

  • Maintenance release: synchronised full product descriptions across product-list renderers.
  • Added consistent padded featured-image presentation to product catalogue cards.
  • No commerce, licensing, payment or customer-data behaviour changed.
sections.installation:
1. Upload and activate Delicious Digital Product Manager.
  2. Go to Digital Products > Settings.
  3. Enable Bank Transfer Payments and enter the payment instructions customers should receive.
  4. Create a product under Digital Products > Products and upload its protected file.
  5. Add a DPM product or products shortcode to a page, or use the available Divi 5 modules if Divi 5 is installed.
  6. When a bank transfer order is paid, open Digital Products > Orders and confirm payment to fulfil the order.
  7. The customer can then access the product from My Digital Products.
sections.faq:
Does Delicious Digital Product Manager require WooCommerce?

No. Delicious Digital Product Manager manages its own digital products, bank transfer orders, customer access and protected downloads.

Does it require Divi?

No. Divi is optional in the Free edition. Shortcodes work with standard WordPress pages. If Divi 5 is installed, five native DPM modules are also available.

Does the Free edition accept payments?

Yes. The Free edition supports manual bank transfer orders. Customers receive your payment instructions and an order reference. You confirm payment in the Orders screen before access is granted.

Are downloads protected?

Yes. Product files are delivered through DPM’s authenticated download system. Access can be granted through fulfilled bank transfer orders or manually through Customer Access.

Does the Free edition include Stripe?

No. Automated Stripe checkout is available in Digital Product Manager Pro.

Does the Free edition create PDF invoices?

No. PDF invoices and receipts are available in Digital Product Manager Pro.

Where can I find documentation?

Documentation is available from the Documentation link in the Digital Products admin menu.
sections.changelog:
2.3.5

  • Expanded the in-dashboard Pro previews to show licence packs, multi-licence customer accounts, Agency/Unlimited tiers, automatic licensed WordPress packages and private update delivery.
  • Added clearer previews of grouped customer/admin licence tools, additional key generation and licence export workflows available in Pro.
  • No Free-edition commerce, licensing or payment functionality was restricted or removed.

2.3.4

  • Corrected the main plugin bootstrap callback after the WordPress.org prefixing update.
  • Hardened custom-table SQL handling and reviewed nonce/capability protection for WordPress.org compliance.
  • Documented read-only request parameters and WordPress core hook usage to avoid false-positive security/prefix warnings.

2.3.2

  • Renamed the plugin to Delicious Digital Product Manager for a distinctive WordPress.org identity.
  • Moved category media JavaScript to the WordPress enqueue system.
  • Hardened request prefixing and protected-file upload handling for WordPress.org compliance.

2.3.0

  • Initial public release of Digital Product Manager Free.
  • Added digital product and category management.
  • Added protected downloads, customer accounts and customer access management.
  • Added manual bank transfer ordering and administrator fulfilment.
  • Added customer and administrator order notifications.
  • Added shortcodes and optional Divi 5 modules.
